description: Badges pop in, a count rolls its digits up or down when the number changes, and a status dot sends out one ring each time the badge's text or count changes.

propDocs.Badge.count: Render a number with rolling digits.
propDocs.Badge.dot: Show a status dot that pulses when its content changes.
propDocs.BadgeDot.className: Classes for the status dot. It carries `data-pulse` (`odd` or `even`) after the first change.
propDocs.Badge.variant: Default, secondary, outline, destructive or success appearance.
